meta: What is vibe coding? Building an app without knowing code: you describe it in words, AI writes the code and shows the app for you to try, then you keep giving feedback.

muc.title: Apps without code
muc.text: You can build a small app just for you without knowing how to write a single line of code.

muc.title: Say it in words, AI writes the code
muc.text: This is called vibe coding. You describe it in words, AI writes the code, then shows the app right away for you to try.

muc.title: Try, give feedback, fix
muc.text: If something isn't right, just keep talking, like make the button bigger or change it to blue, and AI fixes it in seconds.

muc.title: Where to do it
muc.text: Many chatbots like Claude or ChatGPT already have an app preview right inside the chat, nothing extra to install.

muc.title: Your first countdown app
muc.text: Ask a chatbot to make a page that counts down to your birthday, then ask it to add fireworks when the clock hits zero.
